messages:
mira_partnerships: FYI vendor PMs asked for a coordinated image/driver freeze window next Tue 03:00-07:00 UTC. They want us to pin driver/CUDA/ROCm across marketplace images and run a targeted regression scrub. Can owners surface risks and an ops plan?
zhang_runtime: I can own the regression matrix. Need exact kernel/os combos + image tags to validate.
carla_enginfra: Proposed baseline: NVIDIA driver 535.104 + CUDA 12.2 for x86 GPU images; ROCm 5.6 for AMD. Kernel test targets: 5.15, 6.1, 6.5.
alex_dev: +1 on those pins. Suggest we also include a quick quant-kernel smoke for LLMs (FP16/INT8 paths) — last time a CUDA minor bumped caused perf degradation.
ops_oncall: Oncall rota: @ops_oncall will carry the window. Need playbook steps and rollback triggers. If latency P50 > 2x baseline or >5% regression in generation quality on canary prompts = rollback.
zhang_runtime: I'll upload test harness and sample prompts to the canary suite. Plan: smoke -> perf -> quality checks. Canary image tag format: `gcr.io/redwood-inference/runtime:driver-compat-20260320-<kernel>`
mira_partnerships: Vendor asks we avoid breaking marketplace listing artifacts. They'll verify signatures and require a signed artifact list by EOD Fri. Carla, can infra produce the signed manifest?
carla_enginfra: Yes. I'll create a manifest in S3 and sign it with our KMS key. Will post link to the manifest and sha256s once ready. infra-bot: created ticket RW-PLAT-8931 and checklist: https://redwood.internal/issue/RW-PLAT-8931
alex_dev: For rollback, what's the safe fallback? Keep a capacity lane with previous image `runtime:cuda12.1-528.78` pinned and warm-caches?
carla_enginfra: Good call. We'll reserve a warm pool and pre-pull older images to avoid cold start chaos.
ops_oncall: Communication plan: 10m before window post to #release-war-room and partner channel; post-mortem if any incidents.
zhang_runtime: Running matrix will take ~6 hours for full kernel set; I'll prioritize smoke and perf on 5.15 & 6.1 first and report telemetry.
mira_partnerships: Action items: 1) Carla: signed manifest + warm-pool (owner: carla_enginfra). 2) Zhang: canary matrix + perf/quality report (owner: zhang_runtime). 3) Alex: prepare rollback image + cache plan (owner: alex_dev). 4) Ops: oncall coverage + comms (owner: ops_oncall). Everyone ack? :eyes:
carla_enginfra: ACK
zhang_runtime: ACK
alex_dev: ACK
ops_oncall: ACK
infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: freeze-window Tue 03:00-07:00 UTC (RW-PLAT-8931) will post to partners at T-10m.
mira_partnerships: OK closing loop — I'll tell vendor PMs we have owners and timeline. If any new blocker surface, flag here. :thumbsup:
